title: Rofikul Masud
text:
You can call me Rafik. I’m an MSc Computer Science student at the University of Bonn, with an expected graduation in 2028. I completed my bachelor’s degree in Computer Science at Novosibirsk State University in 2025.
My research experience includes machine learning and computational modelling, particularly the interpretation of high-frequency electromagnetic data. You can find my research outputs on the Publications page and more about my education, experience, and projects in my CV.

title: Rofikul Masud
text:
Beyond computer science
I’m interested in contemporary history, philosophy, and literature. Music is another constant, from classical to indie rock and folk. I enjoy learning across these interests and finding new things to explore.
I speak English and Russian, and I’m slowly figuring out German. Feel free to get in touch.

title: Publications
text:
Registered software

BIS — Fast Interpretation of High-Frequency Electromagnetic Sounding Data
Galina Bykova, Alexander Vlasov, and Rofikul Masud.
Registered computer program, Russian Federation. Certificate No. 2024687640, 20 November 2024.
Software for processing and interpreting high-frequency electromagnetic sounding signals during horizontal wellbore drilling. It supports model parameter searches, signal calculation, and target-function evaluation using interval two-layer models, including resistivity, anisotropy, dip angle, and depth. Written in C++ for Windows 10 and later.
